name: core.openwop.agents.document-author
description: Office-document authoring agent — produces PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint deliverables from briefs. Pure-agent pack.
author: OpenWOP Working Group

agents.label: Document Author Agent
agents.description: Authors PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint documents from natural-language briefs. Plans structure and writes the content; the enclosing workflow's core.files PDF/archive nodes materialize the deliverable from what it returns. Mirrors Anthropic's top official Office-document skills (PowerPoint/Excel/Word/PDF).
